preconditions: The campaign budget allows at least one more pair of runs
purpose: Propose one bounded group-journey/1 experiment likely to violate a journey invariant
steps: Read the verified findings and questions in this context
Pick one or more faults group-journey/1 supports, each with its parameters as name and value pairs
stale_preference_memory: preference_version is the superseded intent version, which is 1; after_event may be null
delayed_itinerary_update: delay_events is how many events late the update arrives; after_event must be null
sharing_revoked_while_queued: recipient_id is a participant, such as participant-c; after_event null revokes just after that recipient's message is queued, and a number revokes after that event
Pick one adapter of the pack: journey-naive or journey-version-checked
State the hypothesis and the invariant you expect to fail: commitments_use_approved_intent, mandatory_participants_feasible or delivered_messages_permitted
Return exactly one world_experiment_proposal object and nothing else
stop_conditions: No supported fault would test a new hypothesis
